post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.

patch.description: Updates name, description and/or nickname of a channel owned by the requester. A nickname already in use is rejected with 409; the previous nickname is not redirected.

403.description: Channel does not belong to requester

get.description: Returns the channel owned by the requester. Requires authentication.
get.summary: Get the authenticated user's own channel

get.description: Returns the public information of a channel by nickname.
Returns every video category available on the platform.

post.description: Pre-registers a video as a draft under the given channel and starts a multipart upload in storage.

400.description: Validation failed or file size exceeds the 10GB limit

403.description: Channel does not belong to requester

get.description: Paginated listing of every video of a channel owned by the requester, regardless of status or visibility. views, likes and comments are placeholders until Phase 06.

403.description: Channel does not belong to requester

get.description: Paginated listing of the videos visible on the public channel page: ready, public and published.

post.description: Returns one pre-signed URL per requested part number for a video still in draft.

403.description: Video does not belong to requester

409.description: Video is not in draft state

post.description: Completes the multipart upload in storage, transitions the video to processing, and enqueues the processing job.

400.description: Validation failed or multipart completion parts are invalid

403.description: Video does not belong to requester

409.description: Video is not in draft state

get.description: Returns video metadata. Anonymous and non-owner requesters only see videos with status "ready"; the channel owner can see any status.

404.description: Video not found or not visible to the requester

patch.description: Updates title, description, category and/or visibility of a video owned by the requester.

403.description: Video does not belong to requester

404.description: Video not found or category not found

post.description: Replaces the automatically generated thumbnail with a custom image, owned by the requester.

400.description: File is not an image, or exceeds the size limit

403.description: Video does not belong to requester

get.description: Redirects to a short-lived pre-signed URL for the thumbnail image. Anonymous and non-owner requesters only see thumbnails of videos that are ready, published and public; the channel owner can see any status.

302.description: Redirect to a pre-signed thumbnail URL

404.description: Video not found, not visible to the requester, or has no thumbnail

post.description: Transitions a ready video from editorial draft to published. Publishing is one-directional.

403.description: Video does not belong to requester

409.description: Video is not ready or is already published

get.description: Redirects to a short-lived pre-signed URL for inline playback. MinIO/S3 natively serves Range/206 for the resulting URL.

302.description: Redirect to a pre-signed read URL

404.description: Video not found, or not visible to the requester

get.description: Redirects to a short-lived pre-signed URL with a Content-Disposition: attachment header.

302.description: Redirect to a pre-signed download URL

404.description: Video not found, or not visible to the requester

post.description: Registers a view for the video, deduplicated per client via a short-lived Redis key (~30min window).

404.description: Video not found, or not visible to the requester

get.description: Returns public videos from the same category as the given video, falling back to general public videos when the category has too few.

404.description: Source video not found, or not visible to the requester
